Enrichment_typesBrandInfo.description: Information about the recognized brand on the target page

confidence.description: Level of confidence that the correct brand (or none) was identified

name.description: Name of identified brand in the target page. Null if no brand was identified.

Enrichment_typesCredPhish.description: CredPhish analysis of the screenshot taken for the final URL

confidence.description: Level in a credential phish assessment, only set if .disposition is phishing

contains_captcha.description: Final page contains a captcha test

contains_login.description: Final page resembles a login screen

disposition.description: Verdict of the link, determined by various stages of analysis

created_at.description: When the diagnostic object was created

matched_exclusion_rule_id.description: ID of the customer link exclusion that caused the skip

submit_verdict.description: Reason the URL was [not] submitted to Link Analysis

submit_verdict_url.description: The URL upon which the submit verdict was based

FfiJSON.description: Response from the URL decoded as a JSON object for application/json content types

additional_responses.description: Additional HTTP responses for the page, which could be additional resources, XHR requests, etc.

analyzed.description: Whether the target page was successfully analyzed for credential phishing attempts

files_downloaded.description: All downloads from the page. These must download without interaction and within a few seconds

page_status_code.description: HTTP status code of the page

redirect_history.description: Each URL which the link analysis service was redirected through

retrieved.description: Whether the page was successfully retrieved

status_code.description: HTTP status code for the requested page

submitted.description: Whether the page was submitted to be retrieved for analysis

tags.description: Detection tags emitted by the URL scanner

unique_urls_accessed.description: All unique URLs accessed during the analysis

would_analyze.description: Whether the link would have been analyzed if run in a rule

would_submit.description: Whether the link would have been submitted if run in a rule

status_code.description: HTTP status code for the response

Link_analysis_typesDownloadedFile.description: Raw HTTP response payload as a file

file_extension.description: File extension from context such as headers

file_type.description: File type determined by looking at the magic bytes in the file

md5.description: MD5 hash of the downloaded file

raw.description: Base64 encoded source of the file

sha1.description: SHA1 hash of the downloaded file

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the downloaded file

size.description: Size of the file in bytes

Link_analysis_typesFinalDOM.description: Full DOM of the analyzed URL

display_text.description: Visible text of the HTML document, with invisible characters removed and non-ASCII characters converted to ASCII spaces.

inner_text.description: Inner text of the HTML document that doesn't include HTML tags.

links.description: All links found in the HTML document

raw.description: Decoded raw content of a body text type (text/[subtype] section)

file_extension.description: File extension from context such as headers

file_type.description: File type determined by looking at the magic bytes in the file

raw.description: Base64 encoded source of the file

size.description: Size of the file in bytes

StrelkaDocX.description: Extracts details for a document, and explodes the text for further scanning.

font_colors.description: all non black (#000000) detected font colors. represented as web colors (hex) without '#' prefix.

StrelkaEncryptedDoc.description: Unpacks encrypted doc files by trying to break the password. Does not report totals

cracked_password.description: If the doc was successfully opened, this is the password for the doc.

StrelkaEncryptedPdf.description: Unpacks encrypted PDF files by trying to break the password.

cracked_password.description: If the PDF was successfully opened, this is the password for the PDF.

StrelkaEncryptedZip.description: Unpacks encrypted ZIP files by trying to break the password. Reports total files even if the zip could not be cracked.

cracked_password.description: If the ZIP was successfully opened, this is the password for the zip.

entropy.description: Shannon entropy (log base 2). A higher number means higher entropy.

StrelkaExifTool.description: Responses from the popular ExifTools application

StrelkaFlavors.description: matched yara and mime for file type identification

external.description: Flavors marked by scanners exploding a file

mime.description: Detected MIME type using the libmagic unix utility.

yara.description: Matched YARA rules, for current definitions see [here](https://github.com/sublime-security/strelka/blob/main/build/configs/taste.yara)

StrelkaHTML.description: Scripts and basic details from HTML files. Explodes scripts for further scanning.

scripts.description: All unique identifiers present in JS. unescape and write may be considered suspicious; a variable name is also an identifier.

StrelkaICS.description: Parses iCalendar files and extracts events, attachments, and metadata

StrelkaJavascript.description: Contains details about the types of elements found in a JS script. Very simple scripts might signal obfuscation.

identifiers.description: All unique identifiers present in JS. unescape and write may be considered suspicious; a variable name is also an identifier.

keywords.description: All unique keywords present in JS, e.g. 'if'.

regular_expressions.description: All unique regular expressions present JS.

strings.description: All unique strings present in JS.

tokens.description: All unique tokens/types present in JS. The other values in this type would be present in this list if they occur at all. E.g. a simple script may contain just Identifier & Punctuator (punctuator is not included any further)

StrelkaJpegGif.description: Extracts contents past the GIF trailer for further processing. Empty if there's no data based trailer.

StrelkaLNK.description: Extracted details from LNK files. See ExifTools too.

StrelkaLibArchive.description: Unpacks archives supported by libarchive (including ISO files). Reports totals

StrelkaMachO.description: Unpacks and inspects Mach Objects (executables, libraries, etc)

cpu.description: Details about the CPU/arch the binary is intended for

StrelkaOCR.description: Attempts to find text in images and explodes the text for further scanning.

raw.description: Full text returned from OCR, including whitespace

text.description: Array of words found by OCR

StrelkaOle.description: Unpacks valid OLE files. Reports total files.

StrelkaPDF.description: Unpacks a PDF for further processing. Reports total files.

invalid_urls.description: URLs which could not be parsed

StrelkaPDFObjHash.description: Generates PDF Object Hash of the given PDF file

hash_string.description: Hash string used to generate the object hash for the PDF

object_hash.description: Object hash of the PDF. This is the hash of the object types present in the document.

StrelkaPPTX.description: Extracts details for a powerpoint (pptx) document, and explodes the text for further scanning.

invalid_urls.description: URLs which could not be parsed

StrelkaQR.description: Checks for QR codes and evaluates them

file_extension.description: file extension if known. Using YARA and MIME rules (see .flavors) may provide more accurate detections.

file_name.description: name of the file, or a placeholder. For files exploded from an archive this will be the actual name, but for extracted text, octet stream etc, it will be assigned by the parent to something arbitrary.

node_id.description: ID representing this file in the tree

parent_node_id.description: ID of parent, or not present for the root

StrelkaScan.description: Contains results of all available bin explode scanners. Some scanners explode embedded binaries more than offer scan/analysis. Some of these have total_extracted & total_unextracted (the count of any files remaining after limits are hit). Some exploding scanners have limited analyses, besides the insight into the count of embedded files (see ZIP). RawOCR is an example which explodes, but does not report totals & explodes content which isn't truly an embedded file.

StrelkaStrings.description: Simply finds and extracts any strings from.

raw.description: If the entire input is a string, mirror the input as a single string.

StrelkaURL.description: Detects URLs from text (generally text unpacked by other scanners).

invalid_urls.description: URLs which could not be parsed

StrelkaVBA.description: Examines VBA macros in Ole files, and unpacks macro code for further analysis.

auto_exec.description: All keywords associated with auto exec macros

ioc.description: String values of indicators, such as 'cmd.exe'

suspicious.description: Reported descriptions of suspicious behavior, e.g. 'Run' or 'Hex Strings'

invalid_urls.description: URLs which could not be parsed

visible.description: False if Excel marks this sheet hidden or very-hidden.

StrelkaXML.description: Finds namespaces and other details from XML

version.description: XML version as declared by the document

StrelkaYARA.description: Reports YARA results from custom installed YARA rules.

StrelkaZip.description: Unpacks ZIP files. Reports total files.

all_paths.description: All member paths included in the zip (files and folders)

attempted_files.description: File names, including path, which the scanner attempted to open (cuts off at a limit)

encrypted.description: True if known to be encrypted. scan.encrypted_zip can contain details if password is bypassed.
